ICS 97.140CED 351. ScopeThis standard prescribes the requirements for the following items of wooden furniture meant for use in a library:a) Unit book rack,b) Bay guide holder,c) Book trolley,d) Catalogue cards tray and cabinet,e) Catalogue cards box,f) Catalogue cards work tray,g) Control region fittings,h) Charging trays,j) Reading room table,k) Study table,m) Periodicals display rack,n) Chairs, andp) Display stand.2. REFERENCESThe standards given in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated at Annex A.
